problem.title: Why standard city-wide AQI is not enough for action
problem.card1Desc: One or two CAAQMS monitors cannot reflect ward disparities. While a city average reads 140, valley wards often spike past 350 due to local topography.
problem.card2Desc: Officers cannot distinguish whether a midnight particulate surge is caused by local traffic, industrial clusters, road dust, or stubble fires 40km upwind.
problem.card3Desc: Limited municipal resources (anti-smog guns, mechanical sweepers) are deployed haphazardly without vulnerability weighting for hospitals, schools, and children.

howItWorks.title: How AirTrace MP bridges satellite data to ground enforcement
howItWorks.step1Desc: Ingests CAAQMS ground monitors, VIIRS/MODIS thermal fire anomalies, ERA5 wind vectors, and municipal GIS ward boundaries hourly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Calculates upwind trajectory cones, chemical ratio fingerprints, and boundary layer ventilation coefficients to estimate source shares with confidence scoring.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Combines ward-level AQI with population density, school count, and hospital clusters into an operational priority ranking.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Generates department-targeted mitigation workflows, sends pollution-trap advisories to citizens in Hindi, and logs actions into an audit trail.

features.title: Built for accountable, data-driven air governance
features.feat1Desc: Breaks down hourly pollution into 5 colour-blind safe categories: Fires, Traffic, Dust, Industry, and Other background.
features.feat2Desc: Interactive MapLibre GIS viewer showing high-resolution ward boundaries, fire hotspots, and upwind dispersion wedges.
features.feat3Desc: Directs municipal resources to the top 10 wards where high pollution overlaps with dense populations and pediatric wards.
features.feat4Desc: Early warning detection when ventilation drops below critical thresholds, trapping particulate matter near ground level.
features.feat5Desc: Translates complex microgram sensor readings into plain, actionable Hindi advisory lines for children, asthmatics, and seniors.
features.feat6Desc: Immutable record of all logged mitigation measures, officer assignments, and threshold changes.

psKeywords.title: Aligned with National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) Objectives
psKeywords.kw1Desc: Continuous hourly estimation bridging sparse sensor grids with meteorological dispersion modeling.
psKeywords.kw2Desc: Real-time thermal anomaly fire tracking and automated pollution-trap atmospheric classification.
psKeywords.kw3Desc: Screening micro-climatic inversion events to safeguard climate-vulnerable communities.
psKeywords.kw4Desc: Grassroots citizen reporting, localized SMS warnings, and accessible bilingual health guidance.

trust.title: Built with open governance principles
trust.openDataDesc: All public ward states and priority matrices are accessible via open REST endpoints for researchers and journalists.
trust.statutoryDesc: Designed for immediate rapid-response screening and municipal operational prioritization, not legal source apportionment.
trust.privacyDesc: Citizen alert subscribers are hashed with SHA-256 on the server. Zero personal identifiable data is shared.
trust.accessibilityDesc: Built to WCAG 2.1 AA standards and Indian GIGW 3.0 guidelines with reduced-motion mode and high contrast.
